name: Johanan (son of Tobias)
title: Son of the Ammonite Tobiah
summary: Johanan was the son of the Ammonite Tobiah, one of Nehemiah's opponents. Through marriage, Tobiah's family was linked to prominent families in Judah, which caused division among the people.

keyEvents.title: Married into a Jewish family
keyEvents.description: Johanan, son of Tobias, was married to a daughter of Meshullam, son of Berekiah, which linked Tobiah to the people of Judah.
